lcc_original: 你看，你今日趕逐我離開這地，叫我自己躱藏，不得見你的面，我就會流離飄蕩於地上；那麼凡遇見我的就會殺我了。』
notes: UNV has implicit {<WAH02005>} (הֵן behold) with no explicit character, but LCC has explicit 你看 → per Rule 3 dropped braces and attached as 你看<WAH02005>

Hebrew מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה (from-upon-face-of-the-ground) is compressed to 離開這地 in LCC; WAH04480 attaches to 離開, and WH05921 + {<WH06440>} (still implicit — no explicit 面 for the surface/face of the ground) + WH0127 all attach to 這地
UNV 以致不見<WH05641><WTH8735>你面<WAH04480><WH06440> is restructured in LCC into two clauses: 叫我自己躱藏<WH05641><WTH8735>，不得見你的面<WAH04480><WH06440>; the hide verb maps to 躱藏 and the face phrase to 你的面
LCC 那麼 (then/so) is a Chinese discourse connective with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 了 (aspect particle, sentence-final) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 於 corresponds to the בְּ prefix WAH09002; 地上 carries WH0776 (אֶרֶץ earth), with 上 as a Chinese postposition within the locative compound
